mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS "runId", r.experiment_id AS "experimentId", COALESCE(e.island_id, 0) AS "islandId", COALESCE(e.priority, 50) AS "priority", e.deadline AS "deadline" FROM experiment_run r JOIN experiment e ON e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.id = r.experiment_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 'queued' ORDER BY r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE experiment_run SET control_state = 'NONE' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'queued' AND control_state = 'RESUMING'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT wn.resource_id FROM experiment_process ep JOIN workflow_node wn ON wn.workflow_id = ep.workflow_id AND wn.tenant_id = ep.tenant_id WHERE ep.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ep.experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND wn.resource_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(priority, 50) FROM experiment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{experimentId}
SELECT deadline FROM experiment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{experimentId}
